decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting lies far from the firm's core offer, which limits its ability to learn from early results, but its in-house R&D, testing facilities and maritime customer base give it enough related knowledge to keep the niche line for now.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build directly on the firm's established offer and certified engineering, and the firm is actively extending the line with LED retrofit kits, which shows it is assimilating and improving it.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the firm's core lighting knowledge and was still presented on its own page, though as an older relaunch it carries some risk of replacement.
The pendant office luminaire sits close to the firm's established office lighting expertise, so management can interpret results and refine it with its in-house R&D.

The premium pendant line with several models builds on the firm's existing knowledge and fits its strategy of energy-efficient LED solutions, so the firm can absorb market feedback and develop it further.
